payload.reason: The evidence provides specific factors that contribute to the stability of word embeddings, including properties of the words, data, and algorithms used.

claims.text: The stability of word embeddings is influenced by properties of the words themselves, such as their frequency and part-of-speech.
The data used to train the embeddings affects their stability, with in-domain embeddings recommended for better performance.
The algorithm used to construct the embeddings, such as word2vec or GloVe, plays a significant role in their stability.
Domain-specific factors contribute to the instability of word embeddings, particularly for medium-frequency words.
